description: List content keys (HTML/md); assets: list_assets. 50 keys per page by default: raise limit (≤1000) or pass cursor (nextCursor). Per-row `size`/`missing` are measured on pages of ≤100 rows; past that they're ABSENT (never `null`) unless withSize:true. Only `size: null` + `missing: true` means the page's bytes are gone.

cursor.description: Resume from a prior response's nextCursor.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

withSize.description: Measure size/missing on a page over 100 rows (one storage read per row). Default false; ≤100-row pages are measured anyway.

name: list_content
